# Silicon Steals
> Independent hardware reviews, verified street pricing, and zero-subscription smart home recommendations.

Silicon Steals (https://siliconsteals.com) is a technology editorial and deal intelligence publication. We specialize in evaluating hardware for remote workers, home security enthusiasts, smart home builders, and digital privacy advocates.

## Editorial Principles & Methodology
- Zero Paid Brand Sponsorships: We never accept manufacturer sponsorships or pay-to-play placements.
- True Deal Verification: We track 90-day baseline street prices to expose artificial retailer holiday price inflation vs genuine price drops.
- Subscription-Free Preference: We emphasize local-first, zero-subscription hardware (PoE local NVRs, Matter over Thread, offline-capable smart home hubs).

## Published In-Depth Editorial Reviews
- [GL.iNet Mudi 7 (GL-E5800) Portable 5G Wi-Fi 7 Travel Router](https://siliconsteals.com/mudi_7/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best Portable 5G Router 2026 (9.6/10)
  - Key Specs: Qualcomm X72 5G NR, Wi-Fi 7 BE9300 Tri-Band, 2.5GbE LAN, 5,380mAh battery (13.5h), Hardware WireGuard & OpenVPN acceleration.
  - Verdict: The ultimate privacy-first cellular hotspot for mobile professionals.

- [Reolink 4K PoE Security Camera System RLK8-800B4](https://siliconsteals.com/reolink_poe/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best No-Subscription 4K PoE Security System 2026 (9.2/10)
  - Key Specs: 8-Channel 4K NVR with 2TB HDD, 4x 8MP IP66 bullet cameras, Power-over-Ethernet single cable, onboard person/vehicle AI.
  - Verdict: Gold standard for subscription-free, continuous 24/7 home surveillance.

- [Aqara Smart Lock U200 Kit (Matter over Thread)](https://siliconsteals.com/aqara_u200/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best Retrofit Smart Lock 2026 (9.5/10)
  - Key Specs: Retrofit deadbolt mechanism, Apple Home Key with Express Mode & Power Reserve, Matter over Thread native, IPX5 keypad with fingerprint/PIN/NFC.
  - Verdict: Best retrofit smart lock for multi-ecosystem households and Apple users.

- [Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Performance Mouse](https://siliconsteals.com/logitech_mx_master_3s/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best Ergonomic Productivity Mouse 2026 (9.7/10)
  - Key Specs: 8,000 DPI Darkfield optical sensor, MagSpeed 1,000-line/sec scroll wheel, 90% quieter switches, 70-day battery, Logitech Flow.
  - Verdict: Undisputed productivity champion for software engineers, analysts, and creators.

- [eufy Security SoloCam S340 Wireless Solar 3K Camera](https://siliconsteals.com/eufy_s340/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best Solar Pan & Tilt Security Camera 2026 (9.3/10)
  - Key Specs: Dual-camera 3K wide + 2K telephoto (8x hybrid zoom), 360-degree pan & 70-degree tilt, 2.2W SolarPlus panel (forever power on 2h sun/day), $0 monthly fees.
  - Verdict: Top wire-free perimeter camera eliminating ladder climbing and cloud subscriptions.

- [Cozyla Calendar Plus 2 (15.6" Smart Digital Family Hub)](https://siliconsteals.com/cozyla_calendar/)
  - Award: Editor's Choice: Best Smart Family Command Center 2026 (9.4/10)
  - Key Specs: 15.6" IPS touchscreen, Google Calendar/Apple/Outlook/Cozi sync, Chore charts, Full Google Play Store.
  - Verdict: Replaces paper family chaos with centralized digital schedule synchronization.
